Name: Pigs Can Be Milked Too
Author: Noahglaserphd
Description:
Have you ever looked at your pigs in Stardew Valley and thought, [i]“What if…?”[/i] Well, wonder no more.
[b]Pigs Can Be Milked Too[/b] answers the question that nobody asked but everyone’s going to try anyway. With this mod, your pigs can now be milked just like cows or goats—[i]indoors, of course, because pigs are shy.[/i]
Use your trusty [b]Milk Pail[/b] and approach a fully-grown pig inside a barn to see what happens. If conditions are right, you’ll be rewarded with a fresh bottle of [b]Pig Milk[/b] or even [b]Large Pig Milk[/b] depending on your friendship level. You’ll also be greeted with one of ten random, funny in-game messages to celebrate your questionable achievement.
[line]✅ [b]Milk pigs just like cows[/b] – Works seamlessly with the Milk Pail tool.
✅ [b]Indoor-only milking[/b] – Pigs can only be milked in barns; outside they’ll tell you they’re too shy (same)
✅ [b]Cooldowns and daily limits[/b] – No infinite pig milking shenanigans here. Pigs are like the rest of us
✅ [b]Humorous messages[/b] – Ten unique “You milked a pig” lines to keep things weird and wonderful.
✅ [b]Truffle-friendly[/b] – Pigs will still find truffles outdoors like normal.
✅ [b]Pet bonus[/b] – Milking counts as a positive interaction, giving your pigs a little extra love.
[line][b]How It Works[/b][list=1]
[*]Equip your [b]Milk Pail[/b].

[*]Approach your pig inside the barn and face it.

[*]Use the tool as you would on a cow or goat.

[*]If your pig is ready, you’ll collect Pig Milk (or Large Pig Milk if they really love you).

[*]If not, you’ll see a message like “Baconator has no milk right now.”

[*]If you try to milk outside, the pig will politely remind you: “Baconator can only be milked indoors. Baconator is shy.”

[/list][line]🧑‍🌾 [b]Requirements[/b][list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (latest version)
[*]Works on [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]
[*]Compatible with most animal mods
[/list]
